title: Mollification of a Lipschitz function: smooth, same gradient bound, uniformly close, local (Simon's f^(σ))
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0, g : ℝ^P → ℝ K-Lipschitz and σ > 0. Then there is a C^∞ function g' : ℝ^P → ℝ such that ‖Dg'(x)‖ ≤ K for every x (operator norm of fderiv ℝ g' x), |g'(x) − g(x)| ≤ K·σ for every x, and g'(x) = c whenever x ∈ ℝ^P and c ∈ ℝ are such that g(y) = c for every y in the open ball B_σ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (σ : ℝ), LipschitzWith K g → 0 < σ → ∃ g' : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g' ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g' x‖ ≤ K) ∧ (∀ x, |g' x - g x| ≤ K * σ) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (c : ℝ), (∀ y ∈ ball x σ, g y = c) → g' x = c
